test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The mother said that the kids were playing.

options.text: The mother said, “The kids have been playing”.
The mother has said, “The kids were playing”.
The mother told, “The kids had been playing”.
The mother said, “The kids are playing”.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **​The mother said, “The kids are playing”.**
